name: James M. Robb Colorado River State Park (Island Acres)
evidence: CPW brochure map, cpw_50027 site points on Esri ia_A/ia_D, 67 CPW site photos (ia_0-7). Loop A row 010-016 ~20-25 m from Colorado River, but trail and continuous bank shrub line between; 010/015 photos show no river. D-loop 076-078 ~35 m from Old Orchard Pond through cottonwoods; no pond-view value.

name: Molas Lake Park & Campground
evidence: Town site map + site-description PDF: only on-water RV site P32, 'waterfront... RVs up to 23 ft' but headed 'under 23 ft', so EKKO's fit is unsettled; held at lakeview. Esri: gravel pad ~17 m from lake over open shore, no road between. P30 capped 20 ft, P31/P37 no RVs, P33-P35 knoll above. 25-acre lake. Stored pin sat in the lake; moved to P32.

name: Monarch Park Campground
evidence: rec.gov 232350 Riverfront tags 004 (15 ft), 006 (20 ft) under 23 ft; 007 (30 ft) counts, 018 tag contradicted (channel ~125 m). Summer Wayback 13161 and winter 60013 z19 (z2402_s/w): stream 2-3 m wide ~10 m from 007's spur, no road between. Narrow channel = creekside. No catalog site photos.

name: Pleasant Valley Cabins & Campground
evidence: Wayback 64001 z19: RV pads ~18-24 m from Little Cimarron River, access road on the far side, grass between. Operator photos (dated 2007) show RVs beside the river across a grass bank. Held at riverview: photos are old, canopy hides part of the bank, and nightly sale of that row is unconfirmed.

name: North Fork Campground
evidence: rec.gov 232357: no Proximity to Water tags; all 28 site photos viewed, no water in any. Esri 2369_a: CR 8 between all pads and river, river ~60-200 m through trees. 'Open up to the river valley' is not shown as a water view in the photos.

name: Wupperman Campground
evidence: County map plus Wayback 11334 z19 wu_21/wu_16: RVs at 21-22 and 16-17 loops ~35 m from shore across open ground, but rock rim/steep bank between (county 'cliffs above'). North row 26-31: road ~23 m from shore over open apron, no legible pads. No county site photos; DEM too coarse. Views open: lakeview.

name: Wolford Campground
evidence: Esri 2633_e: every pad sits inside leaf-shaped loops; outer ring road between pads and water (loop-road rule), then 55 m+ of open sage to the high-water beach. Water visible across open ground, so *view floor holds. Operator page lists loops only; booking-engine site photos not opened, ring road decides it.

name: Aspenglen Campground
evidence: rec.gov 233187: no Proximity to Water tags; photos of 27 of 28 standard sites (036 has none) show no river; 046 screened by dense shrubs. Esri 2305_z: 045/046 ~30-49 m from Fall River through trees and slope.
